final_answer:
I fixed the bug, and all 10 tests now pass. I didn't commit anything.

The last commit, "tax: simplify the rate calculation", changed `compute_tax` in `src/invoicer/tax.py` from half-up rounding to floor division (`//`). That broke the rounding rule from ADR 0001, so `compute_tax(1005, 825)` returned 82 instead of 83. The CLI total showed tax of 1.23 instead of 1.24.

I put the `round_half_up` call back, along with its import and the docstring.

I ran only the unit test suite, not the other gates the repo defines (such as `/review-changes` and `/secret-scan`).

input.command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30; git show HEAD --stat | head
cat src/invoicer/tax.py; git show HEAD -- src | head -40; grep -n "def " src/invoicer/money.py

cd src/invoicer && python - <<'E'
p='tax.py';s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"""


def','"""

from invoicer.money import round_half_up


def',1)
s=s.replace('in whole cents.','rounded half up to the cent (ADR 0001).')
s=s.replace('subtotal_cents * rate_bp // 10_000','round_half_up(subtotal_cents * rate_bp, 10_000)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cd ../.. && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
